title: ESQL: multiple column renames intertwined with sort results in NPE

labels.name: Team:QL (Deprecated)
labels.description: Meta label for query languages team

body:
### Description

`FROM employees | eval x = salary | rename x as y | rename y as x | sort x | rename x as y`
